contracts: post-current-pointer directory-sync failure rolls back to the old pointer
rollback replacement failure returns success when the new pointer is actually current
ordinary saves retain prior fallback generations
DELETE makes one bounded eager attempt to retire the pre-delete generation
failed tombstone cleanup retains the complete old response body until collection reclaims it
response missing from live LRU is deleted from verified durable state and cannot resurrect after restart
foreign-session LRU publication blocks across durable DELETE commit
checkpoint and quota rejection preserve live and durable lineage
surviving descendant remains usable under engine-defined ancestry semantics
logical_delete_residual: An active reader or failed tombstone cleanup can retain complete old response bodies in protected stale or tombstone storage until release and successful GC; DELETE is not secure erasure.
windows_behavior: unchanged platform sync implementation; deterministic callbacks precede the production boundaries only in host tests
